[5.3.4](https://appsecg.host/5.3):

> [MODIFIED] Verify that data selection or database queries (e.g. SQL, HQL, NoSQL, Cypher) use parameterized queries, ORMs, entity frameworks, or are otherwise protected from database injection attacks.

Suggested modification:

> [MODIFIED] Verify that data selection or database queries (e.g. SQL, HQL, NoSQL, Cypher) use parameterized queries, ORMs, entity frameworks, or are otherwise protected from database injection attacks. **This should also be considered when writing stored procedures.**
